title: walk-index.json, format 1
description: The index of a walk world: one entry per area file. Contract: docs/walk-areas.md, version 1. Axes: every 3-number vector is in glTF world axes (x east, y up, z = -north), in metres; every field whose name ends in _xy is a plan view in Blender axes (x east, y north), in metres.

format.description: The version of this file's layout. A viewer that does not know the number treats the index as absent.

world.description: A label for people. Nothing reads it.

axes.description: The sentence that says which axes the fields use.

start.description: The spawn the viewer starts at when the address names none.

areas.description: Area id to area. A village section is village_<key>, a room is room_<sceneId>, a wild area is its scene id.

scenes.description: Game scene id to the area ids that make it up. overworld is all the village sections.

pending.description: Game scene ids that are not built yet. A portal into one says so and does not move the player.

vec3.description: glTF world axes, metres: x east, y up, z = -north.

xy.description: Blender plan view, metres: x east, y north.

file.description: The file's name, in the same folder as the index. walk-<areaId>.glb.

bytes.description: The file's size, for the loading bar.

sha256.description: The hash of the file's bytes.

scene.description: The game scene this area belongs to.

name.description: Plain words for people (the Area's wdi_name).

walk_region_xy.description: x0, y0, x1, y1: the rectangle around the ground the player can walk in this file.

walk_polygon_xy.description: Optional: the outline of that ground when it is not the whole rectangle.

look.description: The Area's own look extras, copied: the same keys the viewer reads from the file.

stats.description: Counts read from the file, for tools. The viewer does not need them.

id.description: The node's name without Spawn_. Unique in the whole index.

label.description: The picker's words with the district, as the viewer builds them.

name.description: The picker's words without the district.

group.description: The district the picker groups by.

picker.description: false keeps an arrival-only spawn out of the picker. Left out when the spawn is listed.

id.description: The id the viewer reads: the node's name without Portal_ and without . [ ] : /

portal_id.description: wdi_portal_id: the same id with its dot.

to.description: A game scene id, never an area id.

target_area.description: The area that holds Spawn_<to>_<toSpawn>, or null when the scene is pending.

seam.description: The seam id, on seam portals only.

a.description: The area id of side a.

b.description: The area id of side b.

portals.description: How many portal points each side has.

opening_xy.description: The two ends of the opening on the seam line.

normal_xy.description: The unit direction across the seam, from side a to side b.
